historicalDate.original: 7 September 1743 — exchange of ratifications of the Treaty of Åbo

baseStates.notes: Bounded post-Åbo legal-border state. The independently corroborated 1744–1747 geometry represents the boundary established by the 7 September 1743 ratification exchange; it is used only from that exact treaty month until the dated archive interval begins. No pre-treaty back-projection and no forward proxy.

historicalDate.original: Bounded continuity of the verified 1769–1771 legal-border state until the First Partition acquisition

baseStates.notes: Bounded carry-forward of an already verified legal-border state. It stops before the month of the 27 August 1772 Russian incorporation act, so no later acquisition is projected backward.

historicalDate.original: 27 August 1772 — Russian incorporation act for the First Partition provinces

baseStates.notes: Month-resolution activation at the exact documented First Partition incorporation month. The same independently corroborated geometry is already verified for the dated 1772–1774 interval; this closes only August–November before the existing conservative December anchor.

historicalDate.original: Bounded continuity after the verified 1848 legal-border state and before the Treaty of Paris territorial cession

baseStates.notes: Bounded continuity of the last fully checked pre-Paris legal-border geometry. It ends immediately before the March 1856 Treaty of Paris cession and therefore does not cross the next source-verified territorial change. No wartime occupation is treated as a change to this legal-border track.

historicalDate.original: Bounded continuity of the verified 1969–1972 USSR legal-border state until the 27 March 1975 USSR–Turkey territorial-sea boundary entered into force

baseStates.notes: Bounded carry-forward of the already verified USSR legal-border state. It stops before March 1975, when the separately modeled USSR–Turkey territorial-sea boundary became effective; no post-change geometry is projected backward.
